subject: CrossStack observability connector commercialization
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@datadog.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: CrossStack observability connector commercialization

Alex —

Great to connect at Observability Summit last week. Per our conversation, Redwood has a lightweight inference telemetry plugin that emits RL/latency, token-level cost attribution, and model-variant signals via OTLP. We see a clear customer win if we jointly productize an integration bundle for Datadog and Grafana users: packaged dashboards, alert templates, and a managed OTLP relay mapping to both vendors.

High-level ask: can Datadog and Grafana commit to a commercial pilot (30–90 days) with a mutual action plan that includes co-marketing, joint sales enablement, and a pilot SOW? We think a revenue-share or referral fee model makes sense; included is an initial pricing scenarios spreadsheet and a draft MoU to start legal alignment.

Attachments: CrossStack_MoU_v1.pdf, pricing-scenarios.xlsx

Proposed next steps:
- Align on pilot metrics (ingest TPS, SLOs, retention levels)
- Technical workshop to scope dashboard mapping and OTLP schema decisions
- Legal/Procurement touch-base to agree on licensing & revenue split

Available for a short call Wed/Thu next week (PDT).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0138

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@datadog.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@grafana.com>, NorthStar Labs <partnership@northstarlabs.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CrossStack observability connector commercialization

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the note and the materials. Datadog is interested in exploring a joint offering here. A couple of quick items from our side:

- Procurement & SOW: we'll need an SOW template and clear pilot acceptance criteria (ingest volume, dashboard parity, and error budgets).
- Technical: curious about expected telemetry volume at peak and whether Redwood anticipates sampling or prefix/KV-cache heuristics that would affect event cardinality.
- Commercial: open to a revenue-share model, but legal will want standard vendor terms; please share the MoU and we'll flag redlines.

Can Priya from Grafana loop in any Grafana Cloud-specific constraints? Also looping NorthStar Labs since they suggested being the implementation partner for the dashboard migration piece.

>
> Great to connect at Observability Summit last week. Per our conversation, Redwood has a lightweight inference telemetry plugin that emits RL/latency, token-level cost attribution, and model-variant signals via OTLP...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CrossStack observability connector commercialization

Ben / Vanessa —

Internal read: Alex and Priya are engaged; NorthStar wants to own implementation. I attached a working Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with three pricing tiers and suggested pilot KPIs. Legal flagged two commercial risks in CrossStack_MoU_v1: indemnity carveouts and data-processing clauses (we'll need standard DPAs for Grafana/Datadog relays).

Key asks for the external call:
- Provide expected telemetry envelope (TPS, avg event size, retention) — I put placeholder numbers in the MAP.
- Confirm who owns dashboard maintenance post-pilot (NorthStar vs. Redwood managed service).
- Approve co-marketing timeline (we've penciled a joint webinar in Q4).

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_ga.docx

Link: HubSpot deal HS-987654 for tracking. Confluence draft (internal): https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/CROSSSTACK-ONBOARD

Marissa Cole
Director, Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@datadog.com>, Priya Singh <priya@grafana.com>, NorthStar Labs <partnership@northstarlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CrossStack observability connector commercialization

Thanks everyone — quick alignment and proposed next steps below.

1) Technical workshop
  - Proposed slots: Aug 18 11am PT or Aug 19 9am PT (45m). Agenda attached (tech-workshop-agenda.md).
  - Goal: agree OTLP attribute mapping (model_id, variant, token_latency_ms), dashboard templates, and ingestion throttling strategy.

2) Legal & Procurement
  - I've uploaded the draft MoU to DocuSign and sent an invite to Alex's legal team. Link: https://www.docusign.net/transaction/AAABBBCCC
  - Marissa to coordinate DPAs for Grafana/Datadog relays.

3) Pilot metrics & success criteria (from MAP)
  - Ingest peak: 5K events/s (scale path to 20K)
  - Latency SLO for telemetry: 200ms downstream to dashboards
  - Demo dashboard completion within 30 days of workshop

4) Commercial model
  - Start with referral fee for Datadog/Grafana upsell + implementation services via NorthStar. If product-market fit is strong, transition to revenue share for packaged offering.

Please confirm a workshop slot and procurement contact. If all green, we can execute the MoU and kick off the pilot by end of August.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: tech-workshop-agenda.md
